description: A day-by-day content calendar in the workspace’s own time zone (1 to 31 days, default 14): every scheduled, published and failed post with its local time, saved queue slots, open queue slots and empty-day counts. Use it to spot gaps and pick times accurately. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

days.description: How many consecutive calendar days to return (1 to 31). Defaults to 14.

from.description: Start calendar date in the workspace time zone, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: content_calendar_get
title: Read the content calendar
